connections.why: AO1 Record is the objective the portfolio's observational recording evidences
AO2 Explore is met by experimenting with media and processes
AO3 Develop is shown by exploring and developing ideas in the portfolio
AO4 Present is met by resolving a personal final outcome
Observed material is the raw input for developing ideas
Ideas are pushed forward by experimenting with different media
Media trials lead to the resolved final personal response
Choosing a specialism shapes the media students experiment with
The chosen discipline frames how ideas are explored and developed
Photography is itself a way of recording observations for the portfolio
Idea-development skills built in the portfolio drive the ESA supporting studies
Producing a resolved portfolio outcome prepares for the timed ESA outcome
Supporting studies feed directly into the final timed outcome
The chosen specialism determines the form the ESA outcome takes
The ESA supporting studies are the main evidence for developing ideas
